messages:
incident-bot: PAGE 1776543210 | S2 - spike in 5xxs for hosted inference (us-east1). oncall paged automatically.
lina-oncall: i'm oncall for the window. thanks. drop the runbook and playbook links? i'm jumping in. :raised_hands:
marc-eng: tailing logs now. seeing temp-buffer alloc failures on node-nvidia-21 and node-nvidia-22 followed by upstream resets. traces show sudden memory pressure at 04:11 UTC.
marc-eng: sample errors:
```
2026-03-16T04:11:09Z node-nvidia-22 stderr: TempBufferError: could not allocate working buffer
2026-03-16T04:11:09Z node-nvidia-22 stderr: ConnectionError: upstream reset by peer
```
priya-pd: customer impact calc: approx 11% of requests in us-east1 returned 502/503 between 04:11-04:19 UTC. affected customers flagged: nova-ads, delta-ml. SEs notified.
jon-sec: security hold: preserve all request/response logs and kafka topics for that timeframe. do not rotate or TTL these indices. will need to create evidence bundle.
lina-oncall: infra-bot, take forensic snapshots of node-nvidia-21/22 and pause log-ingest for indices matching "inference-us-east1-*". tag: INC-1776543210
infra-bot: snapshots started for node-nvidia-21, node-nvidia-22. log-ingest paused. evidence staged to s3://incidents/1776543210/evidence/ (preserve until compliance clear).
deploy-bot: recent deploy: quant-kernel commit 88a7f6 rolled to 15% canary at 04:07 UTC. rollbackable via /deploy rollback --commit=88a7f6
marc-eng: that commit includes kernel fuse optimizations. memory alloc patterns changed in perf tests but not in live mem-stress.
lina-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) abort canary & rollback commit 88a7f6; 2) re-route new requests to stable-variant-1 for us-east1; 3) raise KV-cache reserve on affected nodes for short window. who can run?
marc-eng: i'll trigger rollback and bump cache. initiating now.
deploy-bot: rollback started 04:13:34Z -> rollback complete 04:14:20Z for commit 88a7f6.
marc-eng: cache reserve increased on node-nvidia-21/22 at 04:14:45Z.
lina-oncall: routing change to stable-variant-1 applied 04:15:05Z. watching metrics. 5xx rate decaying.
jon-sec: copying chain-of-custody notes here: do not delete S3 objects in s3://incidents/1776543210/evidence/ until compliance signs off. capture IAM events for 03:55-04:30 UTC.
infra-bot: host logs and process dumps archived: s3://incidents/1776543210/evidence/host-dumps/ ; hashes logged in ticket.
priya-pd: declaring incident mitigated 04:19:50Z. status: S2 -> mitigated. initiating post-incident workflow.

lina-oncall: Post-incident actions (short):
- write postmortem + set review meeting
- collect full telemetry + missing shipper metrics
- remediation tasks (rollback guards, mem thresholds)
- security compliance follow-up (audit gap analysis)

marc-eng: i'll draft the timeline + RCA. owner: marc-eng. target: 2026-03-17 EOD.
priya-pd: I'll schedule the postmortem review for 2026-03-19 14:00 UTC (45m). invite: eng-platform, oncall leads, security, compliance, product.
jon-sec: security tasks: 1) recover and verify missing audit events for 04:05-04:20 window; 2) capture IAM change logs; 3) produce evidence bundle with process dumps + config hashes. owner: jon-sec. due: 2026-03-17.
marc-eng: platform tasks: add canary memory health gate and a mem-abort policy in rollout controller. owner: sam-platform (cc: marc-eng). due: 2026-03-24.
priya-pd: customer comms: draft impact notes and share with SEs for nova-ads/delta-ml. owner: priya-pd. due: 2026-03-17.

lina-oncall: FULL ACTION LIST (copy to trackers):
1) PM: postmortem doc + share (owner: marc-eng). due 2026-03-17 EOD. put link in this thread when ready.
2) TELEMETRY: export traces & add missing logshipper/watchdog metrics (owner: observability -> mila). due 2026-03-18.
3) ROLLBACK SAFEGUARD: implement rollout mem-gate + realtime mem heatmap (owner: eng-platform -> sam-platform). due 2026-03-24.
4) LOGSHIPPER RESILIENCE: recover missing audit-forwarder events for 04:05-04:20, add retry/backpressure, and shipper-restart metrics (owner: jon-sec + infra). due 2026-03-19.
5) EVIDENCE BUNDLE: assemble snapshots, host dumps, config commit hashes (owner: infra team). due 2026-03-17.
6) CUSTOMER COMM: SE outreach & shared incident notes (owner: priya-pd). due: 2026-03-17.

marc-eng: note for #3: short-term will add mem-threshold abort in rollout controller and a CI memory-stress job for kernel patches. long-term: automated canary mem regression test.
jon-sec: initial observation: log-forwarder dropped events because its forwarder thread stalled when host hit high swap; we don't have shipper-swap alerts. propose adding host-swap alert and shipper-thread watchdog.
mila (observability): will add shipper-restart and shipper-backpressure counters to telemetry. opening observability ticket OBS-1776.

lina-oncall: chain-of-custody (record):
- infra-bot snapshot start: 04:15:00Z
- evidence S3: s3://incidents/1776543210/evidence/
- kernel commit: 88a7f6 -> sha256:ff88aa77 (include in evidence bundle)
- DO NOT rotate keys for incident bucket until compliance signoff

jon-sec: opened compliance ticket COMP-177654 with request for read-only access for auditors and to preserve IAM logs. attaching evidence checklist.
priya-pd: calendar invite sent for 2026-03-19 14:00 UTC. includes compliance + legal.

marc-eng: draft postmortem live here: https://docs.internal.redwood/postmortems/INC-1776543210 (initial timeline + rollback notes).
infra-bot: preserved telemetry archive to s3://traces/1776543210/trace-archive.zip
jon-sec: 2026-03-16 09:20 UTC - retrieved host core dumps and verified checksums. continuing audit-log reconstruction.

lina-oncall: please update this thread with DONE + date when items complete so we can close follow-ups.

marc-eng: 2026-03-16 16:45 UTC - RCA draft updated: kernel memory allocation regression correlated with fuse optimization path introduced in 88a7f6. missing canary mem gate allowed rollout.
jon-sec: 2026-03-16 17:10 UTC - recovered ~85% of missing audit-forwarder events; remaining gap due to shipper process crash. working on process-level telemetry to fully reconstruct.

(reactions: :white_check_mark: from priya-pd, :eyes: from jon-sec)
